annotations.title: Track a live challenge or funded account

description: For a trader on a live account: from the trade history since the account started, how far the balance is above the maximum-loss floor (static or trailing), what is left of today's daily loss limit and the balance to stop at, progress to the profit target or a payout, the consistency rule and the day counts, with a status. Every trade needs a YYYY-MM-DD close date. Closed trades only: open trades also count at most firms, and the firm's own dashboard is what counts.

challenge_id.description: The PropPassCheck id of the account being traded.

stage.description: Which stage the account is in. Default phase1.

start_date.description: YYYY-MM-DD the account (or this stage) started. Default: the first trade's date.

starting_balance.description: The account's starting balance, for example 100000.

today.description: The trader's own date, YYYY-MM-DD, so "today" matches their day. Default: today in UTC.

trades.description: Closed trades in the order they closed.

date.description: Close date, YYYY-MM-DD. Give it for every trade or for none.

profit.description: Profit (positive) or loss (negative) in account currency, after costs.

name: track_account
title: Track a live challenge or funded account
